title: Track Navigation via Prev Button
summary: Clicking the prev button changes the current track, updating the visible text from 'ukulele' to 'summer'.
assumptions: The prev button cycles through tracks.

criteria.title: Verify Track Change on Prev Click
criteria.given: The user is on the Music Player page with the track 'ukulele' visible.
criteria.when: The user clicks the prev button.
criteria.then: The visible track name changes to 'summer' and the state transitions to state-2.
